label: early MDS baseline
inputs: complete inter-anchor pair graph from sweep1000/pairs_all.csv; directed ranges fused as v1 mean
range_aggregation: Historical field v1-old: bidirectional arithmetic mean of all directed raw ranges; helper AutoPos V1 also uses v1 mean then MDS+NLS
unknowns: anchor coordinates only, gauge fixed by A at origin, B on x-axis, C in xy-plane
cost_function: historical field v1-old: classical MDS stress only; helper AutoPos V1: min_x sum_{i<j}(||A_i-A_j||-r_ij)^2
optimizer: classical MDS; helper path adds scipy least_squares linear loss
constraints: coordinate gauge only; no delay bounds; no physical layer prior in v1-old
outputs: layout.json with anchors and zero delays

label: IVW fusion no-delay
range_aggregation: per direction mean; two directions fused by inverse variance weighting: (var_ba*mean_ab + var_ab*mean_ba)/(var_ab+var_ba)
cost_function: sum pair range residuals plus decaying soft z/coplanarity regularizer lam=0.01 then halved over 3 passes
optimizer: scipy.optimize.least_squares, linear loss, trf/lm chosen by problem size
constraints: coordinate gauge; optional soft z regularization
key_difference_from_previous: better bidirectional range fusion and weak geometric regularization

label: MAD/MVUE no-delay
range_aggregation: per direction median; MAD sigma per direction; MVUE-style fusion with sigma^2 weights
optimizer: classical MDS init plus scipy least_squares linear loss
key_difference_from_previous: robust median/MAD pair aggregation instead of mean/variance IVW

label: robust pair fusion plus per-anchor delay
unknowns: anchor coordinates and per-anchor delays; d_A effectively fixed at 0 because update loop starts at anchor 1
delay_model: independent per-anchor delay by alternating median updates; no explicit bounds; no e_reg
cost_function: IRLS Tukey weighted pair residuals r_ij=||A_i-A_j||+d_i+d_j-r_ij_meas; delay update median over incident links
optimizer: 50 outer IRLS iterations; inner scipy least_squares linear loss on weighted position residuals
constraints: coordinate gauge; Tukey weights can zero pairs
outputs: layout.json with nonzero anchor delays and iteration/zero-weight diagnostics
key_difference_from_previous: first anchor-delay-aware solver, but delay update is alternating and can overfit/outlier-weight badly

label: Huber bounded-delay inter-anchor
range_aggregation: V3 median/MAD/MVUE fused ranges, historically p50-like on raw distribution
unknowns: anchor coordinates and independent d_i for anchors 1..N-1; d_A=0 gauge
delay_model: bounded independent d_i, d_A=0, d_i in [-60,+60] mm for i>0; regularizer d_i/20
cost_function: min_{A,d} Huber([(||A_i-A_j||+d_i+d_j-r_ij)/15, d_i/20, physical_priors]) with f_scale=2 normalized units
constraints: coordinate gauge; delay bounds; soft two-layer physical priors on D and E/F/G/H z/layer gap
outputs: layout.json with positions, bounded delays, physical diagnostics
key_difference_from_previous: joint delay/position optimization with Huber loss, bounds, and physical layout priors; current V4 production anchor solver

label: common-mode delay parameterization
inputs: V3 fused inter-anchor ranges or generated p50/lower-trim variants
range_aggregation: existing official v5-commonmode artifact selected from p50/V3 fused ranges; lower_trim experiment recommends keeping p50 for anchors
unknowns: anchor coordinates, common-mode c, optional per-anchor e_i
delay_model: d_i=c+e_i; no d_A=0 gauge. Existing artifact uses e_reg=20 mm, c=111.985 mm, max |e_i|=15.353 mm. Current code default now e_i=0 unless use_per_anchor_ei/e_reg is explicit.
cost_function: min_{A,c,e} robust([(||A_i-A_j||+c+e_i+c+e_j-r_ij)/sigma, e_i/e_reg, mean(e), physical_priors]); current default Huber f_scale_mm=30, residual_sigma=15
optimizer: scipy.optimize.least_squares(loss configurable, default huber, bounds c +/-150 mm, e +/-100 mm, max_nfev=5000)
constraints: coordinate gauge; common-mode/e bounds; optional e regularization; soft layer priors
outputs: layout.json with common_mode_mm, differential_delay_mm/e_i, pair_rmse, physical diagnostics
key_difference_from_previous: separates bulk common delay from per-anchor residual delays, removing V4 scale-delay leakage; metric scale improves from V4 ~0.958 to V5 ~1.010 in Erlangen analyses
